answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 149209 Country: Bangladesh Title: I have kept my son’s name according to a Sahabah (RZ) name. His name is MIQDAD AHMED NUBAID. Is it ok. If not, what should I do now. He is 1.5 years old now. Question: I have kept my son’s name according to a Sahabah (RZ) name. His name is MIQDAD AHMED NUBAID. Is it ok. If not, what should I do now. He is 1.5 years old now. Answer ID: 149209 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 645/577/SN=6/1438) We could not get the meaning of Nubaid. However, Miqdad Ahmad is a good name, you may keep it. Miqdad was a grand Sahabi about whom Allamah Zahbi writes: كان المقداد سادساً فى الاسلام . Miqdad was the sixth one to accept Islam. (Ruwat al-Tahzibin) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
